SHARED-F-2-S42.title: Consent Data Schema and Pydantic Contracts
SHARED-F-2-S42.description: Define and implement Pydantic models and MongoDB schema contracts for consent records, including tier definitions, timestamps, audit metadata, and de-identification flags. Ensure strict validation and compatibility with existing consent_models.

SHARED-F-2-S43.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Exposure
SHARED-F-2-S43.description: Expose consent capture, update, and retrieval via FastAPI endpoints and tool_router integration, ensuring consent state can be invoked and enforced during chat interactions and tool usage.

SHARED-F-2-S44.title: Cross-Service Consent Enforcement Integration
SHARED-F-2-S44.description: Integrate ConsentService enforcement into dependent domain services including lead capture, unknown question handling, and debug logging to ensure no data storage or processing violates consent tier rules.
